description: This file defines an immutable Java class, ImmutableJsonDouble, which represents a JSON number that can be safely stored as a double precision floating-point value. It includes methods for creating instances, type checks, conversions, equality, hashing, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonDouble
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON number that fits in Java double, providing type checks, comparisons, and serialization logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableJsonDouble instance from a double value.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this object is a double.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the stored value can be represented as an int without loss.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the stored value can be represented as a long without loss.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ImmutableJsonDouble instances and other AbstractJsonNumber objects for value equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the stored number type and value.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the number using the provided SerializationContext, using float or double representation to optimize space.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum string length needed to serialize the number as a string.
